customManagers.description: Keep Chart.yaml version and appVersion equal to the image version (values.yaml image.tag is handled by the helm-values manager)

packageRules.description: Charts: only follow plain x.y.z image tags (no nightly, -lsNN, arch-prefixed or hotfix tags)
Charts: prefix commits and PR titles with the chart name
Jackett releases several times a week: only open a PR on Mondays (UTC) to limit chart releases
